title: ChangeEvent
description: What caches and running work learn of a committed control-plane write (02-lld §2.10): the org's new head revision and what it touched. Written to the outbox in the write's transaction; published on topic `control-plane-events` with key `orgId`. A subscriber that sees `previous` differ from the last revision it applied drops the org's entries (the gap rule). It carries no value of what was written (NTF-13).

narrowing.description: True when the change can only remove authority (nothing in it widens).

live.description: Reserved for references a change revokes (CPD-8's bindings). Never a policy value: an event names what changed, and a holder of the org's live layer reloads it from the internal live route before its next read.
